# gdantas — expanded public source index

This static file helps readers and agents find Gabriel Dantas's canonical public pages. It does not advertise an API, an action interface, content negotiation, or any server-side agent capability.

## Identity and focus

Gabriel Dantas presents his work around Platform Engineering and Developer Experience, including Internal Developer Portals, Backstage, Kubernetes, SRE/DevOps, observability, AI ops, MCP, and retrieval-augmented generation applied to engineering platforms.

- [Home — Portuguese](https://gdantas.com.br/)
- [Home — English](https://gdantas.com.br/en)
- [About — Portuguese](https://gdantas.com.br/about)
- [About — English](https://gdantas.com.br/en/about)
